note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Congress's copies (its legislation API's files; the state's own sites answer behind a Cloudflare check). The Ley de Hacienda del Estado de Sonora (Congress's copy of Feb 2026, its last decree listed of 12 Dec 2025), art. 316, charges an automovilista licence by its term: $410.00 for one year, $701.00 for two, $952.00 for three, $1,195.00 for four and $1,773.00 for five; the one-year term and its fee are held. The Ley de Control Vehicular para el Estado de Sonora (version of 12 Dec 2025) gives the issuing of licences to the Secretaría (the Secretaría de Hacienda del Poder Ejecutivo del Estado) (arts. 3, XXIX and 5, II) and asks an automovilista applicant to be over eighteen (mayor de 18 años) (art. 39, A, I); a person of 16 or 17 may have a permit for one or two years (art. 39, F), not held. The Ley de Tránsito del Estado de Sonora names the automovilista licence (art. 18, I).
